verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference with runnable examples is a fair question for a developer framework like Mastra, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents one. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every path. Studio is a separate agent-testing interface, and llms.txt/docs.md and cloneable templates are related documentation features, not an interactive, runnable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
